name: Tribute to Tim Maia
description: Groove to the soulful sounds of Brazil. This tribute to the legendary Tim Maia is sure to be a vibrant and energetic night of classic tunes.
longDescription:
On May 21, 2026, the Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club hosts a musical tribute to Tim Maia, the influential Brazilian singer-songwriter. Known for his distinctive voice and pioneering blend of soul, funk, and bossa nova, Maia's career spanned several decades, leaving behind a significant catalog of popular songs. This evening's performance will feature a live band interpreting his classic compositions.

Attendees can expect an evening of Brazilian music in the intimate setting of the Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club. The performance will focus on the rhythmic and melodic elements characteristic of Maia's work, encouraging dancing and a lively atmosphere. The club, known for its live music events, provides a close-up experience with the performers.

Tickets for the event are available from €17.24. The Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club is located in central Porto, within walking distance of the São Bento metro station and train station. It is also easily accessible by various bus routes serving the city center.
